description: Statistics Poland published the housing results of the 2021 National Population and Housing Census as a report with a workbook of tables. Thirteen building tables count residential buildings and their dwellings by period of construction, number of dwellings, connection to a water supply system and sewerage, mains gas and central heating, by building type and form of ownership, with several tables split by the 16 voivodships and one for unoccupied buildings. Thirty-one dwelling tables describe occupied dwellings by rooms, useful floor area, installations (water supply, toilet, bathroom, gas), ownership and legal title, construction period, heating method, the fuel or energy used for individual heating, persons per room and substandard conditions, and list unoccupied dwellings. Headings are in Polish and English. Format and access: one XLSX workbook and a PDF report, free to download; GUS also links an API portal and the Geostatistics Portal from its census pages. Licence: the GUS copyright note allows copying and adapting data on condition that the source is given; free. Caveats: the tables stop at voivodship level, so municipal or grid detail needs other GUS products, and the workbook layout is for reading, not for machine use. Simulation uses: national and regional building stock age, utility connection and heating fuel shares for energy, water and retrofit models. Related records: the GUS commuting flow matrix and the GUS transport statistics.
